test_case.description: POS - Verify that the Language Analysis component accurately identifies Falls Risk Enable intent without location argument.
test_case.setup: Pre-Requisites: Make sure to have access to Language Analysis component. Test setup depends on the Language Analysis component being used. Refer Module HFW Language Analysis Component Setup. LLM Context: call-state: Not on a call. alert-state: No active alert to respond to. has-notifications: false. Test Data Sets: HFW Patient Safety Risk Indicators as [R], HFW Enable Patient Safety Risk Commands For Valid Risk Indicators as [C].
test_case.steps:
Step 1. Send [C].[Command Phrase] from the first row in [C] with [Risk Indicator] argument replaced by first row in [R].[Risk Indicator] to Language Analysis component.
Step 2. Repeat step #1 for all remaining rows in [C] with combinations for rows 2 to 8 in [R].
Step 3. Calculate the passing percentage of the voice command intent detection with falls risk indicator and without location arguments for all rows combined for steps #1 to #2.
test_case.expectedResults:
Step 1. Language Analysis component shall identify the Falls Risk Enable Intent and Language Analysis Response shall contain identified intent as per [C].[Expected Intent].
Step 2. N/A
Step 3. Voice accuracy shall be at least 75% for voice command intent and argument detection combined.

upstream_requirements.text: At least 75% of the time, the system shall accurately identify a voice sequence argument spoken in English by Handsfree Wearable device users with a natural language of General American English or Standard Canadian English without a dialect or accent.

At least 80% of the time, the system shall accurately identify a supported voice command intent spoken in English by Handsfree Wearable device users with a natural language of General American English or Standard Canadian English without a dialect or accent.
The Gateway service shall be able to determine a voice command's enable and disable falls risk indicator intent.
The user can use voice commands to send a request to external systems (e.g., Nurse Call) to turn on risk indicators for a patient per requirements (see References).
